correctness.rationale: The stationary spectral representation and Edelman–Kostlan identity yield an exact energy deficit. A sawtooth-plus-Lipschitz decomposition proves a sharp 1/(1-r) circular energy law with O(log^2) integrable remainder. The interface integral is exactly pi/(w_-w_+); radial integration gives the stated coefficient and O(1) remainder. Compact-uniform local Poisson estimates give the boundary profile. A separately executed checker passed 120 finite assertions for explicit spectra; these are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete sharp second-order zero-count asymptotic for a natural broad class of positive discontinuous coefficient spectra, showing logarithmic loss without spectral zeros and identifying an additive scale-invariant interface invariant. It bridges bounded smooth-positive corrections and spectral-zero power corrections; the local arctangent profile explains the global coefficient.
